Episode 178. Deepening Concerns (1)
King Lani.
After rescuing Yona and returning, Jin was able to meet the king who suddenly came to see him in Tikan.

The one who called her to Tikan was Owl, and the reason why Lani responded to his request was because Mumeong had now formally joined the Barmel Union. If Owl had contacted her as Mumeong, not as part of the Barmel Union, Lani wouldn't have accepted.
“Almost three years after returning as a recluse, there's someone here who doesn't show their face but only sends letters and assigns difficult tasks?”
Lani said, pretending to be offended.

After Jin returned as a recluse, she had taken full charge of healing Talaris, who was sent to the holy kingdom, and she also checked on Valeria, who was hurt by Runtia, but this was the first time she had seen Jin in person.
Jin gave an awkward smile. Despite meeting a familiar face after a long time, Jin couldn't express joy.
“Lani.”
“Hey. I thought I'd tease you a little since it's been a long time, but the mood doesn't seem right. I guess I don't need to explain that I'm not really upset?”
“Of course.”
Lani patted Jin's shoulder.
She, too, as a king and a key figure in the anti-chaos force, was having a hard time, but the burdens placed on Jin's shoulders seemed much heavier, and it hurt her heart.

“Thanks to you and Murakan, I would have been dead, and the Holy Kingdom would have been exploited under Ziphil's command. Right now, as soon as I return, I am struggling with all my might for the world.”
“It just happened that way in my personal quest to regain my family.”
“Even so, Ayura will always bless you. So don't worry too much about Lady Yona. I don't know her well, but hearing the story from King Mumeong, she seems like a good person.”
Jin's face had been dark because of Yona.
“...Yes. Lady Yona is indeed a good person.”
Rescuing Yona was nothing but joy.

There was no fatal damage to the allied camp during the rescue process, Yona did not undergo the physical transformation that Jin was most worried about, and even the king came to prepare for any problems that could arise during the purification of chaos.
However, Yona's chaos was not purified.
“Even though the chaos hasn't been completely purified like others, at least we've managed to prevent it from running wild like before.”
As she said, the purification device was not ineffective on Yona.
While purification was impossible, Yona's chaos had now entered a state of 'stability' similar to before.
Like when Yona was overcoming her chaos by herself before Gliac's power stimulated it.
This was because the chaos Yona possessed was so immense. There were limits to the extent to which Boras's purifier could intervene in that chaos.
'It's probably similar to the situation with Ringring and myself from before...'
If Yona's chaos, like Ringring, separated from her and became an annoying yet somewhat cute and useful entity, it would be better, but half of it was currently in Lafrarosa.
Even if the half would come forward, it was frustrating that there was no guarantee that it could be separated in the same way as it was during Ringring's time.
But she couldn't just keep worrying about it.
Anyway, it was a fact that the situation with Yona had improved so much that it couldn't be compared to before.
"Thank you, Lani. I've been too caught up in my own thoughts. You came all the way here in person, and I don't have Murakan to offer you. What should I do."
As soon as she arrived at Tikan, Lani asked about the well-being of Murakan after examining Yona.
"It's a pity. It's like she's acting as a deputy of a deputy in Soldierlet... It seems like a remarkable yet clumsy position, which is befitting of Lord Murakan."
In order for Murakan to return, the recovery of Talaris is the most important situation. Because Talaris was injured, Misha is bearing the burden of Elona's seal.
"There's something I have to discuss regarding Bigungju."
"Is it bad news?"
"Well, it's not good news. It's not that there's a problem with Bigungju's recovery. It's just that the recovery is slow because the time I have to devote to her is gradually decreasing."
"There's another problem in the Holy Kingdom..."
Lani nodded.
"Yes, the demon's relic that our kingdom is keeping. Zito's Eye is showing bad signs recently."
"Zito's Eye?"
The defense war of the Holy Kingdom that broke out when the demons invaded Bankella five hundred years ago is a famous war.
However, not only the saints of Bankella, Runkandel, and Ziphil unusually combined forces to defend, it was not just the believers of the Holy Kingdom.

"You might not be familiar with the name Zito. He hasn't been active in the recluse, and even in the demon world, there are few who know his name. Even after I became the king, I couldn't confirm the records about Zito's Eye."
"So even you, the king, couldn't access the records about that item?"
"That's right. I only recently found out that Zito's Eye exists in the kingdom, and it's showing bad signs. Ayura warned me in a dream."
Lani, recalling the dream she had a few days ago, trembled as if in pain.

"The vision Ayulra showed me was a future where Jito had returned through that artifact. The entire world was burning, and it included the sight of all the defenders of the mortal world, including you and Murakan, dying."
If someone else had said this, it might be dismissed as nonsense, but Lani was the Holy King. She couldn't have confused a simple nightmare with a warning from Ayulra.
"We're already struggling against Rosa, and now you're saying a new formidable enemy might appear."
"To prevent that, I'm following Ayulra's warning and controlling Jito's Eye. Because I'm using almost all of my holy power for that task, the treatment for Bi-Gungju is being delayed."
"Do you have any idea why Jito's Eye started showing unusual phenomena? Perhaps it was affected by the remnants of the chaos Glik left behind."
"She didn't mention anything specific about that. But I have some guess."
"I also have one in mind."
Kinjero.

Currently, they are the only ones controlling the devils in the mortal world. Kinjero has always had high-ranking devils like Bianca, and they've recruited more powerful figures from the demon world while Jin was visiting Laprarosa.
"I've heard that Ogre King Orgal, who was revealed as the leader of Kinjero, is one of the rulers of the demon world. I think he must be related to this incident."
"It's an obvious story. From the start, they keep gathering devils in Kinjero, and it would be possible because they have built some sort of passage that connects somewhere to the demon world."

"It's known that the devil society completely fell after the holy kingdom defense war, but it's likely as you say. Even if it's not an external dimension, they could bring in devils through rituals such as summoning."
"Summoning....."

-Ah, Ranke Halovich. You certainly have some perseverance. Anyway, according to your explanation, the reason why the desert is like this is because all forces used it as an experimental processing area after the contamination. You just liked this place and used it as a playground?
-The first one makes sense, but the second one is insufficient. You were trying to do something here.
-Just... I like it here, *cough*, that's all.
The conversation after beating Ranke as soon as they entered the mortal world.
Jin had thought even then that Ranke didn't just consider the desert as a playground, but after talking with Lani, it felt even more suspicious.
"From the start, Kinjero was probably trying to find Jito's Eye along with the bio-experiment during the holy kingdom incident."
"I think so too. At that time, we only focused on the bio-golem experiment, but the real purpose of Kinjero must have been Jito's Eye."
"Is it not a problem that you're holding Jito's Eye so it doesn't cause more trouble with your holy power?"
"For now, it is. But there's no precedent for this kind of problem, and the information given by Ayulra is too limited..."
If Murakan were here, he would have questioned why his Ayulra only gave vague warnings.
Rani suddenly chuckled at the thought that popped into her head, and then pondered for a moment whether it amounted to blasphemy or not.

"So, it's not an urgent issue, but it's like a bomb that could explode at any time. Given that Ayulra, a deity who extremely detests intervening in the Human World, directly warned about it, the situation could be disastrous if it explodes."
"Probably it would be okay until Ayulra manifests again to tell us."
"I have some business with Kinjelo and I need your permission for something."
"Permission?"
"Is it okay to talk about the Eye of Jito directly to Orgal?"
"Of course."
"Good, I'll gather any information about the Eye of Jito from Kinjelo and share it."
"They might want the Veil Sphere, but would they easily give out information?"
"If they act ignorant or say nothing even when I explicitly mention the Eye of Jito, that will be enough. It means the information is too important to leak out."

"That makes sense. It seems like you're about to leave, but how about having a cup of tea with me first? I don't have a space teleportation ship like the Red Owl, so I came here by a regular spaceship."
"Of course. I'll send a space teleportation ship to the Holy Kingdom when it becomes possible to mass-produce them in the future."
"Oh, I gained another promise from you. Since I am a guest, let me make the tea!"
Kinjelo's headquarters.
They were excited about finally seeing the traces of life they had longed for today...
Unfortunately, the Veil had already made a deal with Sandra, so the joy was somewhat dampened.
Despite Jin standing in front of him, Orgal didn't hide his disappointment.
[Really, you've already made a deal with Sandra Zif... It's hard to believe even after hearing it.]

"Hearing such a disappointed voice makes me feel guilty. What can I do, Orgal. It happened right after the seal of the Veil was released. Anyway, I kept my promise. There was nothing about a private conversation between you and the Veil in that, so it would be best if all conversations take place where I can hear."
[Hoo, I don't mind that. Cough...cough...]
"I'm glad to hear that. And there's something I want to ask."
[What is it?]
"What do you think of the Demon King Jito?"
At Jin's sudden question, Orgal coughed continuously.
Fortunately, he seemed to have improved a bit, as he didn't bleed as much as before.
